title: Failover steward and probationary evacuation mollifier
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: a recent incident (SUP-4021) exposed an oscillation during cross-region failover: aggressive eviction in region A caused mass rejoin attempts to region B which in turn triggered localized overload and additional evictions. This change introduces a small coordination component (Failover Steward) and a probationary evacuation mollifier to reduce reverberation during regional failovers.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces a Failover Steward in the control plane that sequences evacuations and enforces a probationary window before full rejoin for tenants that were evacuated. The steward mediates rejoin probes and records probation credits.
- Adds an Evacuation Mollifier component that applies a decaying dampening factor to aggressive eviction scoring; penalizes immediate rejoin traffic that matches recent eviction cohorts.
- Adds a soft egress quarantine policy: heavy-tail egress from an evacuated tenant is routed to a graceful fallback model variant for a short probationary period instead of immediate regional egress.
- Exposes two new telemetry counters and one histogram for probation window success/failure and quarantine hit-rate.
- Includes unit and integration tests and a small runbook describing operator actions.

Implementation notes:
- steward.go is a compact coordinator that stores probation timers in the control-plane KV with a short TTL; decision logic is deterministic and idempotent to avoid races during HA control-plane leader flips.
- mollifier uses an exponential decay factor tuned with the incident traces (default half-life 120s). The heuristic is conservative to avoid dropping requests prematurely.
- quarantine policy is implemented in the routing layer; it prefers local cheap fallback variants and only falls back to cross-region egress when both local fallback capacity and probation window have been exhausted.

Checklist: 
- [x] Unit tests for steward decision paths
- [x] Integration test that simulates rapid-evac/rejoin cycles
- [x] Telemetry metrics added and registered
- [x] Documentation: runbook and config knobs
- [x] Canary rollout plan appended to the runbook

Rollout plan: start canary in a single zone for 2 hours under traffic shadowing; enable probation window at 0.1 fraction of traffic, increase to 10% over 48 hours if no regressions; fully enable after one week with metrics eyes on error rate, latency P99, and quarantine hit-rate.

Notes about safety: defaults are opt-in (failover.steward.enabled=false) and probation defaults are short (30s) to avoid blocking legitimate traffic for extended periods. We included a fast rollback path: helm value failover.steward.enabled=false will stop new probation assignments and let timers expire naturally.

Related: ENG-2147 contains the incident timeline and sample traces used to tune decay constants. SUP-4021 is the oncall ticket that triggered this.

review_comments: Jonah Brenner: This looks solid; one question on KV TTL sizing — if control-plane leaders bounce quickly we could orphan probation entries. Can we store a small leaderEpoch alongside the TTL to detect stale assignments?
Aisha Kapoor: Good point — added leaderEpoch and deterministic compare-and-swap in steward.go (see commit b2d7c6e). TTLs remain short (default 60s) and steward will refresh on leadership renewals.
Priya Mehta: Integration test passes locally but CI flaked on the initial run (timeout in eviction simulation). Can we increase the test deadline and make the simulation deterministic?
Aisha Kapoor: Increased deterministic timers and added a retry loop for the simulated probe. Reran CI.
Samir Patel: Approving — metrics look useful. Please add an alert (SLO: increased probation-failure-rate) after canary if we see >1% failures over 5m.
Aisha Kapoor: Added alert note in runbook and a placeholder in charts/helm for operators to wire into pager policy.
release_notes: Introduce Failover Steward and probationary evacuation mollifier to reduce rejoin oscillation during regional failovers; adds egress quarantine routing and telemetry. Opt-in behind failover.steward.enabled.
